newsitem.title: UK: HK London stocks buoyed by rampant HSBC.
newsitem.headline: HK London stocks buoyed by rampant HSBC.

text.p: The Hang Seng London Reference Index hit another record peak on Wednesday, boosted by more strong gains for a rampant HSBC Holdings, dealers said.

HSBC shares climbed as high as HK$274 in London trade and were at HK$272.625 by 1420 GMT, after climbing HK$10 to a close of $264.00 in Hong Kong. Dealers said the strength of the company's London-listed shares had boosted its Hong Kong stock.
"HSBC is still roaring ahead and that has propelled the index into record levels," one dealer said. "Most of the rise is accounted for by HSBC, which is putting in an incredible performance."
The Hang Seng London Reference index reached a high of 15,597.96 in early-afternoon trade and was at 15,591.68 by 1420 GMT, up 145.66 points or 0.94 percent from Hong Kong's close.
